svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Get in-app guidance on advanced trading algorithms beyond the basic ones → Understand new
algorithms that can be used to generate profits

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Have comprehensive Academy content on futures and options trading → Become more financiall
y literate, including understanding how markets work

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Become more financially literate, including understanding how markets work → Save up money
through long-term financial planning so that funds are available after retirement

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Place orders by voice (voice based orders) → Avoid having to go into the app all the time
just to check whatever he wants to ask

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Get voice based summarization → Avoid having to go into the app all the time just to check
whatever he wants to ask

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
See the portfolio dashboard giving, in one page, the day's picture: what went up, what wen
t down and the net profit or loss → Track every day how his investments and the market hav
e moved, including which stocks are performing well or not

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Track every day how his investments and the market have moved, including which stocks are
performing well or not → Realign (rebalance) investments about every two weeks to a month
based on review

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Integrate a bank account with the trading app seamlessly, with onboarding made as easy as
possible → Make a trade instantly and with the least amount of time and effort

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Keep cryptocurrency investment to blue chip coins (bitcoin, ethereum, polygon) as relative
ly safe investments → Avoid exposure to highly volatile cryptocurrencies and to scam coins

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 待确认联系 · 范围具体化
See financial news as a queue of headlines, each marked positive or negative (green or red
) for the particular stock or cryptocurrency → Have a separate interface in the app for fi
nancial news that explains what happened in the market and can affect different stocks

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
Have the option of investing in mutual funds in the app, apart from just stocks → Save up
money through long-term financial planning so that funds are available after retirement

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 待确认联系 · 实现方式
Keep the amount invested in stocks much higher than the amount invested in cryptocurrencie
s → Avoid exposure to highly volatile cryptocurrencies and to scam coins
